issue.title: microCMSによるヘルプコンテンツ配信基盤

summary: Create a server-side microCMS Help adapter with redacted public content models, caching, preview separation, and resilient fallback states.
decisions: microCMS credentials stay server-side and are never exposed to the browser or Agent.
The product consumes a narrow Help content DTO rather than raw CMS responses.
Preview/draft content cannot appear in production without an explicit authorized preview path.
requirementRefs: REQUIREMENTS.md#11-セキュリティと受け入れ

risks.description: A CMS key may reach browser code, logs, or Agent context.
risks.mitigation: Use server-only environment access, redact errors, and contract-test public responses.

risks.description: Draft or preview content may be shown publicly.
risks.mitigation: Separate published queries and production-disabled preview authorization.

risks.description: A provider outage may block Help navigation.
risks.mitigation: Bound timeouts, cache last valid published content, and render explicit fallback guidance.

gates.description: Provide the approved staging service/domain, content model, and least-privilege read credential through secret storage.
Verify server-only credential use, public DTO allowlist, error redaction, and preview isolation.

acceptanceCriteria: CMS credentials and raw provider errors never reach the browser or logs.
Published index/detail responses expose only the approved Help DTO.
Draft preview is authenticated and forcibly disabled in production unless explicitly designed and approved.
Timeout, not-found, rate-limit, and provider error behavior is covered with a fake.
Staging retrieves approved published content and records redacted provider evidence.

rollback.strategy: Disable the live CMS adapter and serve the last valid/fallback Help response; do not expose provider errors.
rollback.verification: Help remains reachable with an explicit fallback and no secret appears in browser payloads or logs.
